records.gloss_en: to press or squeeze something so that it takes up less space
records.collocation: compress a file · compress the material · compress the image
records.example_en: You can compress the photo to reduce its file size.
records.example_zh: 你可以压缩照片来缩小文件大小。
records.grammar_note: compress是动词，常接文件、图片或可被压紧的物体作宾语。
records.contrast_note: compress强调使体积或数据大小变小；compact可作形容词表示紧凑的。
records.editorial_reason: Use of data compression is a well-established extension of reducing size; example does not imply lossless compression.

records.gloss_en: to cook food in hot oil or fat
records.collocation: fry an egg · fry in oil · pan-fried vegetables
records.example_en: She fried two eggs for breakfast.
records.example_zh: 她煎了两个鸡蛋当早餐。
records.contrast_note: fry通常用油脂煎或炸；boil是在水等液体中煮。
records.editorial_reason: An egg can be pan-fried; Chinese 煎 accurately describes the context.

records.gloss_en: in a way that shows good manners and respect for other people
records.collocation: ask politely · reply politely · politely decline
records.contrast_note: politely描述行为或表达方式；kindly还可表示善意或用作礼貌请求语。
records.editorial_reason: Polite refusal is a productive and clear adverbial usage.

records.gloss_zh: 个性化；按个人需要定制
records.gloss_en: to change or design something to suit a particular person
records.collocation: personalize an account · personalize the settings · personalized recommendations
records.example_en: You can personalize the app settings to suit your needs.
records.example_zh: 你可以根据自己的需要个性化设置这个应用。
records.grammar_note: personalize为及物动词；personalized可作形容词。
records.contrast_note: personalize按个人偏好定制；customize范围较广，不一定针对某个具体用户。
records.editorial_reason: Software settings are a natural direct object; example does not assert any unavailable app feature.

records.gloss_en: a substance added to something to improve or change its properties
records.collocation: food additive · chemical additive · artificial additive
records.example_en: The label lists every food additive used in the product.
records.example_zh: 标签列出了该产品使用的每一种食品添加剂。
records.contrast_note: additive是添加到产品中的物质；ingredient是更宽泛的配料或成分。
records.editorial_reason: Distinguishes additive from the adjectival mathematics sense, respecting frozen source noun scope.

records.gloss_en: a sloping surface connecting two different levels
records.collocation: wheelchair ramp · access ramp · loading ramp
records.example_en: The building has a ramp beside the stairs.
records.example_zh: 这栋建筑在楼梯旁设有坡道。
records.grammar_note: ramp为可数名词，常与for、to连接用途或目的地。
records.contrast_note: ramp作名词指斜坡或坡道；ramp up是表示增加或加快的短语动词。
records.editorial_reason: Accessibility example illustrates physical graded surface without presuming ramp standards.

records.gloss_en: a team sport played with an oval ball that players carry, pass, or kick
records.collocation: play rugby · rugby match · rugby team
records.example_en: They play rugby at school every Friday.
records.example_zh: 他们每周五都在学校打英式橄榄球。
records.grammar_note: rugby作为运动名称通常不可数；不说a rugby来指一场比赛。
records.contrast_note: rugby指英式橄榄球运动；American football是另一类运动。
records.editorial_reason: Sports label and Chinese translation distinguish rugby from US football.

records.gloss_en: a piece of cloth hung to cover a window or separate an area
records.collocation: draw the curtains · close the curtains · shower curtain
records.example_en: She closed the curtains before going to bed.
records.grammar_note: curtain可数；指一扇窗上的两片窗帘时常用复数curtains。
records.contrast_note: curtain通常指布质窗帘或幕帘；blind常指百叶帘或卷帘。
records.editorial_reason: Collocations demonstrate curtain as movable fabric, not a theatrical metaphor.

records.gloss_en: a section of extra information placed at the end of a book or document
records.collocation: in the appendix · technical appendix · an appendix to the report
records.example_en: The full survey questions are listed in the appendix.
records.example_zh: 完整的调查问卷题目列在附录中。
records.grammar_note: 本义作附录时可数，复数为appendices或appendixes。
records.contrast_note: appendix可指文档附录，也可指人体阑尾；本记录仅教学文档附录义。
records.editorial_reason: Unambiguous document-specific sense; retains note on separate anatomical sense.

records.gloss_en: to make something last longer than it otherwise would
records.collocation: prolong the meeting · prolong the process · prolong a person's life
records.example_en: The discussion may prolong the meeting.
records.example_zh: 这场讨论可能会延长会议时间。
records.grammar_note: prolong为及物动词，通常后接活动或持续时间相关名词。
records.contrast_note: prolong强调延长既有过程的持续时间；postpone指推迟开始或发生的时间。
records.editorial_reason: Meeting length extension vs schedule postponement contrast is pedagogically useful.

records.gloss_en: connected with sending and delivering letters or parcels
records.collocation: postal service · postal address · postal code
records.example_en: Please write your postal code on the form.
records.example_zh: 请在表格上填写你的邮政编码。
records.grammar_note: postal为形容词，通常置于名词之前。
records.contrast_note: postal与邮政系统相关；email address是电子邮箱地址，不是postal address。
records.editorial_reason: Simple adjective-noun usage, accurate postal code collocation.

records.gloss_en: a brass musical instrument played by blowing into a mouthpiece
records.collocation: play the trumpet · trumpet player · brass trumpet
records.example_en: She has played the trumpet since childhood.
records.grammar_note: 表示演奏乐器时通常说play the trumpet。
records.contrast_note: trumpet在这里指铜管乐器小号；horn可指其他号类乐器或喇叭，不能直接等同。
records.editorial_reason: The instrument sense is fixed; avoids trumpet as verb meaning announce loudly.

records.gloss_en: not protected against danger or likely to cause harm
records.collocation: unsafe conditions · unsafe to use · feel unsafe
records.example_en: The bridge is unsafe to cross after the storm.
records.example_zh: 暴风雨后，这座桥不宜安全通行。
records.grammar_note: unsafe可用于be unsafe to do something或unsafe conditions等结构，表示某行为或环境存在危险。
records.contrast_note: unsafe表示存在危险或安全性不足；uncomfortable仅表示不舒服，不一定危险。
records.editorial_reason: Physical safety sense; Chinese translation can be refined to 灾后过桥不安全.

records.gloss_en: ordinary and not especially interesting or exciting
records.collocation: mundane tasks · mundane routine · mundane details
records.example_en: He was tired of doing the same mundane tasks every day.
records.example_zh: 他厌倦了每天做同样枯燥的日常事务。
records.grammar_note: mundane是形容词，通常置于名词之前。
records.contrast_note: mundane强调普通而乏味；routine本身只表示例行，不一定带有负面感受。
records.editorial_reason: Boring everyday tasks are archetypal mundane usage without denigrating ordinary work.

records.gloss_en: the act of officially recording a name or details on a list or system
records.collocation: online registration · registration form · registration deadline
records.example_zh: 网上报名将于午夜截止。
records.grammar_note: registration通常为不可数名词，指某项报名或登记制度时可接具体限定语。
records.contrast_note: registration是登记或注册过程；reservation通常指提前预订某项服务或位置。
records.editorial_reason: Online enrolment context natural; avoids conflating a registration with hotel reservation.

source_provenance: Newly authored bilingual examples and notes; no external dictionary sentences copied. Permission for upstream text if applicable is distinct.
